messages:
talia: Heads up: hitting a parity issue between JS SDK 1.2.0 and REST when passing sampling params. REST accepts `topP`/`topK` but the SDK sends `top_p`/`top_k` and our gateway ignores them. quick repro below.

jon: can you paste the minimal curl + SDK snippet?

talia: sure:
```bash
# REST curl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","topP":0.9,"topK":40,"prompt":"hello"}'
# JS SDK (fails to change sampling)
node -e "const R=require('redwood'); const c=new R.Client(); c.generate({model:'rwd-3b',top_p:0.9,top_k:40,prompt:'hello'}).then(console.log).catch(console.error)"
```

rui: confirmed. I ran the gateway logs and saw the SDK request body only had prompt+model, no sampling fields. Looks like the TS serializer drops unknown snake_case keys.

jon: we intentionally map snake_case to camelCase in some places for older users, but seems the mapping table doesn't include sampling params. Might be a regression from the typed-config refactor.

talia: impact: starter-kits call SDK with snake_case options, so their sampling post-upgrade changed to greedy. I found one internal ticket and one community forum thread complaining of less diverse completions.

rui: interestingly the REST client has a separate header X-Redwood-Retry that triggers gateway retry semantics. The SDK 1.2.0 stopped setting that header during the http client swap, so 429 handling differs too (REST triggers gateway retries; SDK returns 429 immediately).

jon: that's bad. Customers expecting automatic retries on transient 429s will break. we should prioritize a patch.

eng-docs-bot: Note created: docs/sdk-mapping-and-retry-parity (internal).

talia: mitigation options: (A) quick SDK patch to remap sampling params on the client-side; (B) patch gateway to accept both camel and snake names (backwards compatible) but that's more invasive. My vote: patch SDK first and add an e2e.

rui: i'll open a PR to restore the header and wire retry middleware in the JS client. also add unit tests asserting header is present and retry behavior mirrors REST: 3 retries, exponential backoff, honor Retry-After.

jon: i'll own the param mapping PR across both python and js SDKs. let's standardize on sending camelCase to the API but accept snake_case in SDK user inputs. Add a deprecation warning when snake_case is used and log telemetry.

talia: please add an integration test to starter-chat repo that runs non-default config and asserts sample diversity > threshold. helps catch regressions.

rui: CI: I've kicked off a canary run for the patched JS client against staging gateway. tagging @ci-bot.

ci-bot: CI queued: SDK patch PR #4410. Starter-chat e2e run scheduled.

jon: timeline? if we can get fixes merged in ~36 hours we should cut a patch release and roll to beta customers.

rui: agree. i'll target a quick 1.2.1 release for JS and coordinate a 0.9.3 for python.

talia: thanks. i'll update the SDK migration guide and add a short note in the onboarding checklist: "Use camelCase in requests or rely on SDK mapping; watch out for sampling defaults post-upgrade."

jon: also add a small telemetry event when sampling params are remapped so we can measure how many customers were affected.

talia: ok. marking follow-ups: PRs #4410 (js retry), #4411 (js param map), #4412 (py param map), #4413 (starter-chat e2e). will reopen if more reports show up.

rui: cheers.
